messages:
Ana (Product): quick async check-in for the quarterly milestone: unified routing + canary rollout. Short status: shipped routing policy API v1 to prod (see deploy bot below). Canary rollout is blocked by infra quota for Dedicated pool (we're at ~70%).

Shipped:
- routing policy API v1 (core endpoints) :shipit:
- initial model-variant catalog entries for canary

Slipped:
- canary gradual rollout (blocked by infra capacity and a small SRE playbook gap)

Blockers / deps:
- infra: free up reserved nodes or grant temporary burst (owner: Sam)
- SRE: finalize canary runbook + preemption guard (owner: Jess)
- Eng-ML: provide evaluation prompt set for canary quality checks (owner: Michael)
- Design: sign-off on fallback UX and banner copy (owner: Olivia)

Next steps (owners & ETA):
- Sam -> check quota + propose burst plan by EOD today
- Jess -> publish canary runbook draft and run pre-run checklist by tomorrow noon
- Michael -> upload eval prompts & baseline metrics to the eval dashboard by EOD tomorrow
- Olivia -> provide final banner copy and acceptance criteria by EOD today

Link refs:
- canary playbook (draft): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-playbook
- eval dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/canary-unified-routing

Please reply with short updates (one-liners) so we can mark shipped/slipped and unblock. If anything needs to be escalated to the oncall or legal, flag it here.

Sam (Eng): Looking. We currently have ~70% of Dedicated pool reserved for other tenants; I can try a temporary burst request to infra but need approval from capacity owners. If we get approval I can provision 4 GPU nodes by EOD. Also ping me about the PR review (PR link below).

Michael (Eng-ML): I'll own eval prompts. Quick ask: do you want a conservative set (40 prompts) or broad set (200)? Conservative first for the canary, then expand. I'll push the 40 -> eval dashboard tonight.

Jess (Eng-SRE): Noted. There's also a preemption window during nightly batch jobs that could disrupt canary traffic. Draft runbook is here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/sre-canary-template
Small check I run locally to audit capacity:
```
# list instances tagged for inference
gcloud compute instances list --filter="tags:inference" --format="table(name,status,machineType)"
```
I'll add the preemption guard (node affinity + anti-preempt labels) to the runbook and link back.

deploy-bot: Deploy success — routing-policy-api v1.0 -> prod (2024-11-05 14:12 UTC) :white_check_mark:

Sam (Eng): FYI PR waiting on review: https://git.redwood/repo/routing/pull/4321 (adds canary flag toggle + metrics). If someone from eng can take a quick pass, I can merge and run smoke tests.

Olivia (Design): Proposed banner copy for fallback when canary is active: "We’re rolling out an update to inference routing. You may see brief differences in responses — report problems via the in-app Feedback menu."
Acceptance criteria: banner shows only for 5% traffic and links to feedback modal. I can mock the banner if you want a screenshot.

Ana (Product): Good. Owners + ETAs sound fine. Quick checklist for me to close the loop:
- Sam: confirm burst plan ("approved" or "needs exec signoff") by EOD (if exec signoff needed we escalate)
- Jess: publish runbook + add preemption guard PR by tomorrow 12:00
- Michael: upload 40-prompt eval set & baseline metrics by tomorrow EOD
- Olivia: final copy + screenshot by EOD today

If all green, target starting canary at 09:00 UTC day-after-tomorrow and ramp 5% -> 25% over 4 hours. If not green, we hold and re-evaluate at the weekly milestone sync.

Sam (Eng): ack and pinging capacity owners now :thumbsup:
